relic-mastodon-super-heavy-siege-transpo.name: Relic Mastodon Super-heavy Siege Transport
relic-mastodon-super-heavy-siege-transpo.transport:
This unit can transport friendly DEATHWATCH models in one of the following combinations:
- Up to 40 INFANTRY models.
- Up to 30 INFANTRY models and 1 DREADNOUGHT model.
- Up to 20 INFANTRY models and up to 2 DREADNOUGHT models. 
TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

storm-eagle-assault-gunship.name: Storm Eagle Assault Gunship
storm-eagle-assault-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

caestus-assault-ram.name: Caestus Assault Ram
caestus-assault-ram.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK, CENTURION or TERMINATOR models.

thunderhawk-assault-gunship.name: Thunderhawk Assault Gunship
thunderhawk-assault-gunship.transport:
This unit can transport friendly DEATHWATCH models in one of the following combinations:
- Up to 30 INFANTRY (excluding PRIMARIS) or BIKER models.
- Up to 15 PRIMARIS INFANTRY models.
Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models.

thunderhawk-transporter.name: Thunderhawk Transporter
thunderhawk-transporter.transport:
This unit can transport up to 15 friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY or BIKER models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

In addition, this unit can also transport one of the following:
- 1 LAND RAIDER model or RELIC SPARTAN ASSAULT TANK model.
- Up to 2 of the following models: RHINO, RAZORBACK, PREDATOR, WHIRLWIND, HUNTER, STALKER, VINDICATOR. 

LAND RAIDER, RELIC SPARTAN ASSAULT TANK, RHINO and RAZORBACK models can transport models whilst they are embarked aboard this unit.

sokar-pattern-stormbird.name: Sokar Pattern Stormbird
sokar-pattern-stormbird.transport: This unit can transport up to 50 friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY or BIKER models, or up to 25 friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY or BIKER models amd 1 RHINO model. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models. A RHINO can transport models whilst it is embarked aboard this unit.

damocles-command-rhino.name: Damocles Command Rhino
damocles-command-rhino.transport: This unit can transport 1 friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY CHARACTER model. It cannot transport PRIMARIS, CENTURION or TERMINATOR model

lucius-pattern-dreadnought-drop-pod.name: Lucius Pattern Dreadnought Drop Pod
lucius-pattern-dreadnought-drop-pod.transport: This unit can transport 1 friendly DEATHWATCH DREADNOUGHT model.

castellum-stronghold-tacticus-bunker.name: Castellum Stronghold - Tacticus Bunker
castellum-stronghold-tacticus-bunker.transport: This unit can transport up to 30 friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models.

castellum-stronghold-bunker-annex.name: Castellum Stronghold - Bunker Annex
castellum-stronghold-bunker-annex.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly DEATHWATCH INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models.

watch-master.name: Watch Master
watch-master.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly DEATHWATCH units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

unstoppable-champion.name: Unstoppable Champion
unstoppable-champion.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can remove one small blast marker from this unit.

blackstar-cluster-launcher.name: Blackstar Cluster Launcher
blackstar-cluster-launcher.text: When this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll two D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a CHARACTER; for each result of 5+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

total-obliteration.name: Total Obliteration
total-obliteration.text: When this unit's detachment carries out the Aimed Fire order and this unit makes a Shoot action, double the Attacks characteristic of any Melta Rifles it is equipped with for that action.

omni-scramblers.name: Omni-scramblers
omni-scramblers.text: Enemy units cannot be set up within 12" of this unit during the Set Up Reinforcements step.

haywire-mine.name: Haywire Mine

multi-spectrum-gunsights.name: Multi-spectrum Gunsights
multi-spectrum-gunsights.text: Do not apply negative modifiers to hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons by this unit.

narthecium.name: Narthecium
narthecium.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly DEATHWATCH LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

rites-of-battle.name: Rites of Battle
rites-of-battle.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DEATHWATCH units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

litanies-of-hate.name: Litanies of Hate
litanies-of-hate.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly DEATHWATCH units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

spiritual-leader.name: Spiritual Leader
spiritual-leader.text: Friendly DEATHWATCH units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

castellum-stronghold.name: Castellum Stronghold
castellum-stronghold.text: This unit can only be included in a Fortification Network Detachment that only includes 1 DEATHWATCH Tacticus Bunker unit and 3 DEATHWATCH Bunker Annex units. All 3 Bunker Annex units occupy a single Fortification slot, and the Tacticus Bunker begins the battle as the Commander of its Detachment.

blessing-of-the-omnissiah.name: Blessing of the Omnissiah
blessing-of-the-omnissiah.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly DEATHWATCH VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.
